title: The Eager helper at the door
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：eager　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eager 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the craftsman wrote of ① an eager helper at the door in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② eagerrer than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the eager ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the eagerrest helper at the door anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too eager to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the eager ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an eager hope in her voice, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as eager as the hope in her voice they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was eager or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something eager, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite eager; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the eager ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, twice over, she wrote of another eager helper at the door in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ eagerrer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The eagerrest hope in her voice in the whole workshop, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the eager ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 热切（前置定语 an eager helper at the door：1966 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件热切的人）
B. adj. 热切／渴望（比较级 eagerrer than：文中两处，一处比门口自告奋勇的人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 热切／渴望（最高级 the eagerrest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 热切（表语 too eager to do：母亲觉得它太热切，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 渴望（前置定语 an eager hope in her voice：叔叔把整件事称作一桩渴望的期盼）
F. adj. 渴望（同级比较 as eager as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩她话里的期盼相比）
G. adj. 渴望（后置定语 something eager：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 渴望（受程度副词修饰 quite eager：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an eager helper at the door
the eagerrest helper at the door anybody
an eager hope in her voice
The eagerrest hope in her voice in

answers.why: eager 意为“热切”，1966 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件热切的人”，此处作前置定语 an eager helper at the door。
eager 意为“热切”，此处用比较级 eagerrer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
eager 意为“热切”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最热切的一件，故用最高级 the eagerrest helper at the door。
eager 意为“热切”，母亲认为这件东西“太热切了，谁也用不上”，too eager to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
eager 意为“渴望”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩渴望的期盼”，此处作前置定语 an eager hope in her voice。
eager 意为“渴望”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩她话里的期盼一样渴望”，同级比较用 as eager as。
eager 意为“渴望”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“渴望的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something eager。
eager 意为“渴望”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当渴望”，quite 修饰原级 eager。
eager 意为“渴望”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要渴望”，故用比较级 eagerrer than。
eager 意为“渴望”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个工坊里最渴望的那一桩”，故用最高级 the eagerrest hope in her voice。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件热切的人。（an eager helper at the door）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更热切。（eagerrer than …）
母亲觉得它太热切，谁也用不上。（too eager to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩渴望的期盼。（an eager hope in her voice）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩她话里的期盼一样渴望。（as eager as …）
到了 1973 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件渴望的东西。（something eager）
answers: In 1966 the craftsman wrote of an eager helper at the door in the ledger.
Everybody said it was eagerrer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too eager to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an eager hope in her voice.
He said nobody would call it as eager as the hope in her voice they had once had.
By 1973 the ledger asked for nothing but something eager.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 eager 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the craftsman wrote of an eager helper at the door in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the eagerrest helper at the door in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too eager to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an eager hope in her voice, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite eager, and everybody laughed.
The eager ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
